headline: Take-Two gets smashed 4.4% on GTA 6 concerns while Labor's CGT-linked tax cuts and Pope Leo's AI regulation push dominate headlines — wet day on the Coast with 94% rain chance.

portfolio.summary: Take-Two is the clear standout mover, down 4.4% on ongoing GTA 6 noise. Alphabet slipped 1.2% — not alarming given recent earnings strength. The ASX-listed ETFs (VGE, VTS, VDHG) all nudged higher, which is a decent sign for the diversified side of the book. CBA gave back 65 cents, nothing dramatic. MSFT and FUEL.AX barely moved.

movers.name: Take-Two Interactive
movers.note: Dropped sharply. GTA 6 narrative continues to weigh — commentary around the title being 'too big' and pricing uncertainty (USD $70 rumours circulating). High expectations are a double-edged sword here.

movers.name: Alphabet Inc. (Google)
movers.note: Mild pullback after recent earnings strength. Google launched Gemini Omni today — AI momentum story remains intact.

movers.name: Vanguard FTSE Emerging Markets ETF
movers.note: Solid lift. AUD/USD ticking up to 0.7172 is a mild headwind for USD-denominated holdings but emerging markets catching a bid.

movers.name: Commonwealth Bank of Australia
movers.note: Small dip, likely tracking RBA rate expectations softening. Nothing to act on.

movers.name: Vanguard US Total Market Shares ETF
movers.note: Quiet positive session, consistent with S&P 500 and NASDAQ both grinding higher.

movers.name: Vanguard Diversified High Growth ETF
movers.note: Steady gain, reflecting broad market positivity across the diversified basket.

markets.summary: Markets broadly positive overnight. S&P 500 and ASX 200 both up around 0.4%, NASDAQ up modestly. Gold barely moved. Oil flat at $96.60 — though there's some downward pressure from US-Iran deal hopes. AUD pushed up to 0.7172, strongest in a while, which mildly dilutes returns on your USD holdings.

indicators.name: AUD/USD
indicators.note: AUD strengthening despite RBA rate hike odds fading — watch this.

indicators.name: Crude Oil (WTI)
indicators.note: Flat. Iran deal hopes capping upside.

politics.summary: Two big threads in Aussie politics today: RBA rate expectations are shifting fast, with bond markets pricing out hikes and the AUD still rising regardless. Labor is playing hardball on tax cuts, linking them to CGT and negative gearing reform — that's a major story for property investors and anyone with a share portfolio.

stories.title: Labor to tie tax cuts to CGT, negative gearing changes
stories.why_it_matters: Labor is using popular income tax cuts as leverage to push through CGT and negative gearing reforms. If this gets up, it reshapes property investment economics and could hit sentiment on REITs and property-exposed stocks. Worth watching closely.

stories.title: RBA interest rate rise bets, government debt fears unwind, triggering demand for Australian bonds
stories.why_it_matters: Markets are unwinding RBA hike bets and piling into Aussie bonds. Good for rate-sensitive stocks (utilities, REITs) and signals the tightening cycle may be done. CBA and other banks could face margin pressure if rates plateau or fall.

stories.title: Why is the Australian Dollar rising despite weakening RBA rate hike odds?
stories.why_it_matters: Normally a weaker rate outlook drags the AUD down. The fact it's rising anyway suggests commodity demand or global risk-on flows. A higher AUD reduces the Aussie-dollar value of your US holdings — worth monitoring.

stories.title: Temporary fall in inflation won't ease RBA fears
stories.why_it_matters: Even if inflation dips near-term, the RBA isn't ready to declare victory. Keeps the rate outlook murky — mixed signals for bank stocks and the broader economy.

ai.summary: Two big stories today: Google dropped Gemini Omni, a notable product launch for your GOOGL holding. And Pope Leo XIV's first encyclical has put AI regulation front and centre globally — calling for oversight in finance and warfare. The papal push gives political momentum to AI regulation efforts worldwide.

stories.title: Introducing Gemini Omni
stories.why_it_matters: Google has launched Gemini Omni, its latest multimodal AI model. Directly relevant to GOOGL — keeps Alphabet competitive in the AI race against OpenAI and Anthropic. Positive signal for the holding despite today's price dip.

stories.title: Pope Leo Calls For AI Regulation And Protecting The Dignity Of Workers In First Encyclical
stories.why_it_matters: Pope Leo XIV's encyclical calls for robust AI regulation, specifically flagging risks in finance and warfare. It's a cultural and political moment that will embolden regulators globally. Not an immediate threat to AI stocks, but adds to the regulatory headwind narrative.

stories.title: Pope Leo Warns of AI Risks, Calls for Oversight in Finance & War
stories.why_it_matters: Specific focus on AI in financial systems and autonomous weapons. This framing will resonate with EU and UN regulators. Keep an eye on how MSFT and GOOGL respond publicly — both have significant government and defence contracts.

sport.summary: A sad day for Australian sport — Neale Daniher, AFL legend and the face of the Fight MND campaign, has passed away at 65 after a 13-year battle with motor neurone disease. On the NRL front, Round 13 team news is coming together with injury concerns at the Tigers and Warriors. A WSL surf event in NZ is on hold after an Australian photographer was bitten by what may have been a shark or sea lion.

stories.title: Neale Daniher, football legend and Fight MND campaigner, dies aged 65
stories.why_it_matters: Daniher was one of the great figures in Australian football — both as a Melbourne coach and as the driving force behind Fight MND, raising tens of millions for research. A genuine loss for the country, not just the game.

stories.title: NRL round 13 predicted teams: Mystery surrounds Origin stars; Tigers, Warriors cop major injury blows
stories.why_it_matters: Round 13 injury news is breaking — Tigers and Warriors both copping it. Origin selection uncertainty adds another layer heading into a big week of footy.

stories.title: World Surf League event in NZ put on hold after Australian photographer bitten by 'shark or a sea lion'
stories.why_it_matters: WSL event paused after a scary incident in NZ waters. No further details on severity yet — worth keeping an eye on if you follow the tour.

stories.title: 'Wasn't a fluke': Team stuns with 20-minute blitz
stories.why_it_matters: A team blitzed their opponent with a stunning 20-minute run in Round 12. Round 13 draw is coming up — could set the tone for the week.

watch_today.title: Take-Two (TTWO) down 4.4% — GTA 6 risk building
watch_today.detail: The stock is sliding on narrative risk around GTA 6 — scope concerns and pricing uncertainty. Not a fundamental earnings event today, but if this continues into the week it's worth reviewing your position size. No need to panic-sell, but have a price level in mind.

watch_today.title: Labor's CGT + negative gearing reform linked to tax cuts
watch_today.detail: This is a genuine policy risk if you hold property or REITs. Labor is using income tax cut popularity as political cover to push structural changes to CGT and negative gearing. Watch for Senate positioning this week.

watch_today.title: AUD rising despite RBA rate hike odds fading
watch_today.detail: Your USD-denominated holdings (GOOGL, MSFT, TTWO, VTS) take a small hit every time AUD strengthens. At 0.7172 it's worth noting — not alarming yet, but the trend is moving against you on FX.

watch_today.title: Google launches Gemini Omni — positive for GOOGL
watch_today.detail: New multimodal AI model dropped today. Keeps Alphabet in the race and supports the long-term thesis on your GOOGL position despite today's minor price dip.

watch_today.title: Neale Daniher passes away at 65
watch_today.detail: Not a market event, but a significant moment for Australian sport and culture. The AFL community is in mourning. Big Match donations to Fight MND may spike today if you want to contribute.
